ai.title: Commander agent supports timeoutseconds
ai.summary: The Commander agent in `.agents/commander.ts` now accepts a `timeout_seconds` parameter. This value is passed through to the `run_terminal_command` tool, enabling control over execution duration (default 30, -1 for none).

eli5.text: A background assistant that runs terminal commands can now be given a time limit on how long each command is allowed to run. If you're giving it instructions, you can say how many seconds a command should be allowed before it gets stopped, or set it to -1 if you want it to run as long as it needs. Without that setting, each command times out after 30 seconds by default. This just landed today in the internal tooling.

ai.title: codesearch SDK tool now emits context lines
ai.summary: The `code_search` SDK tool now processes both `match` and `context` event types from the underlying search engine, rather than ignoring `context` events. A new `fileMatchCounts` map tracks actual matches separately from total output lines, ensuring that context lines are included in the output without consuming the `maxResults` or `globalMaxResults` quotas. This change applies to the `codeSearch` function in `sdk/src/tools/code-search.ts`, affecting how search results are grouped and truncated for SDK consumers.

eli5.text: If you run a code search through the developer kit, you'll now see the lines of code around each match (the surrounding context) instead of just the matching line itself. The search tool now listens for both the match events and the context events from the search engine, and it counts only actual matches against your result limits while including context lines in the output for free. This is live today for anyone using the code search tool in the SDK.

ai.title: base2-max promotes base2-gpt-5
ai.summary: Removed base2-gpt-5 definition. createBase2 hardcodes isGpt5 for 'max' mode. base2-gpt-5-worker moved to .agents-graveyard. Tool lists updated: removed spawn_agent_inline, consolidated best-of-n-orchestrator logic.

eli5.text: If you use the "max" version of the system, it now automatically uses the newer GPT-5 model instead of requiring a separate setup for it. The old separate GPT-5 worker has been moved to an archive folder and the code has been simplified so that only the "max" option turns on GPT-5. This means you get GPT-5 capabilities right away when you choose the max mode, without any extra configuration.

ai.title: Best-of-N agents set reasoning effort high for GPT-5
ai.summary: Best-of-N implementor and selector agents now inject `reasoningOptions: { effort: 'high' }` when model is `gpt-5`. Conditional spread ensures options apply only to GPT-5, leaving Sonnet unchanged. Internal logic in `.agents/base2/best-of-n/best-of-n-implementor.ts` and `.agents/base2/best-of-n/best-of-n-selector.ts`.

eli5.text: When the system runs its internal 'best-of-N' reasoning process on GPT-5, it now tells GPT-5 to put in extra effort to think harder before responding. You wouldn't notice this directly, but any internal analysis or implementation planning that uses GPT-5 will get more thorough, deliberate answers from the model. Systems still using Claude Sonnet are unaffected and behave exactly as before.

ai.title: Fix import paths in base2-gpt-5-worker agent
ai.summary: Corrected relative import paths for `createBase2` and `SecretAgentDefinition` in `base2-gpt-5-worker.ts`. The file was moved from `.agents-graveyard` to `.agents/base2/task-researcher`, requiring updated path references to resolve module dependencies correctly. This change affects only the internal agent definition file.

eli5.text: An internal assistant definition file was moved from an old location to a new one, and the paths it uses to find its supporting components were updated to match. This only affects the internal tooling used to build and run research agents, not anything you interact with directly. If you looked at the project structure, you would see the file now lives alongside the task-researcher agents instead of in the abandoned-agents folder, and its references point to the correct nearby locations.

ai.title: Add base2-plan agent and planOnly option to createBase2
ai.summary: New `base2-plan` agent defined in `.agents/base2/base2-plan.ts` using `createBase2('fast', { planOnly: true })`. `createBase2` in `.agents/base2/base2.ts` accepts `planOnly` flag, disabling `file-researcher` spawn and altering instructions when true. Best-of-N orchestrator prompts in `.agents/base2/best-of-n/` clarified to forbid input prompts.

eli5.text: The assistant can now produce a written implementation plan without actually writing any code or files, letting a human review the approach before any changes happen. It does this by adding a new planning mode that skips the step of automatically searching and reading project files. The instructions for the multi-attempt orchestrator were also tightened so it only uses the conversation history as context and never accepts a custom prompt. These changes are live today.
